oncall-bot: PAGE: [P1] High error rate on hosted-generation-prod (eu-west-1) — 503 spikes, 12% failed requests over last 3m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-gen-rate-errors Please ACK and indicate who will take primary.
Incident Bot: Created incident INC-2026-101, priority P1. Paging primary: Sam. Bridge: #inc-1729456789-bridge.
Sam: ack. oncall-ing. I'm primary but need to step away at 22:30 UTC (unexpected family emergency). I can keep the bridge open until then. Current findings: error-rate peaked when workers autoscaled, suspect OOMs in raptor-worker. Rolling back model variant to v2-quant reduced errors from 12% -> ~3% in last 90s.
Priya: I can pick up full primary at 22:30 UTC until 04:00 UTC. @Sam — what's the current mitigation steps you ran? Any hotfixes applied?
Sam: thanks @Priya. Steps run so far: 1) rolled back to v2-quant 2) scaled down worker-concurrency from 16 -> 8 3) disabled some experimental KV-prefetch flag. No code deploys. Logs: `kubectl logs -n prod raptor-abcde | tail -n 200` show repeated `std::bad_alloc` before crash.
Arnav: copying notes. If it's memory spikes, restarting the worker will help short term. Prefer safe action: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/raptor-worker -n prod --field-selector metadata.name=raptor-abcde` (confirm pods get healthy). Runbook step excerpt: ```Safe mitigations:
  - rollback model to earlier quantized variant
  - reduce concurrency to 8
  - toggle kv_prefetch=false (feature flag)
  - if errors remain >5% escalate to infra on-call for node investigation
```
Priya: ok I'll take primary at 22:30. Before Sam leaves can you drop a short checklist for me (services to watch, dashboards, customer list)? Also is there a known customer impact?
Sam: checklist: 1) watch `hosted-gen-5xx-rate` and `request_latency_p95` on graphana -> eu-west-1 dash 2) open bridge -> #inc-1729456789-bridge 3) run `curl -s https://metrics.internal/api?m=hosted-gen-errors&period=5m` to get quick numbers 4) check top customer logs: `s3://prod-logs/hosted-gen/eu/*/last-1h` 5) if errors stay >7% for >10m, call infra pager. Impact: visible for ~6% of production traffic; two enterprise customers reported increased 503s in last 10m, on support pages.
Priya: got it. I'll take over at 22:30. On the bridge now to shadow for 10.
Incident Bot: Note: support ticket #SUP-3328 created for customer-reported outage. Link: https://support.redwood.com/t/SUP-3328
Evelyn: thanks team. @Sam, take care — we can run post-incident follow-up. @Priya @Arnav, please annotate runbook with any extra commands you needed so we can avoid thrash next time.
Arnav: quick pointer for Priya after takeover: check node memory usage with `kubectl top pod raptor-abcde -n prod` and node allocs `redis-cli -h metrics get node:alloc` (internal). If you see growing RSS across pods, escalate infra. Also watch for `OOMKill` events: `kubectl get events -n prod --field-selector reason=OOMKilled`.
Priya: on it. First glance: errors down to 2.9% post-rollback, p95 latency stable. I'll leave autoscale disabled for the moment. If things keep stable I'll hand back to rotation at 04:00 UTC.
Sam: leaving bridge now, thanks all. If anything spikes, page me and I can VPN in for a quick look but can't commit to full coverage. <3
Priya: thanks @Sam, take care. I'm primary until 04:00 UTC. I'll post a short summary in the incident ticket and update runbook with the `kv_prefetch` flag note.
Evelyn: nominate follow-up owners: Priya for immediate RCA notes, Arnav to triage infra traces, Sam to own postmortem doc draft. We'll schedule a 60m follow-up tomorrow.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-101 status -> mitigated (errors <4% for 10m). Please add postmortem checklist entries.
Priya: closing bridge for now (keeping monitoring on). If anyone sees regressions ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Arnav: good job. Leaving a quick snippet for runbook additions: `if model rollback reduces error by >50% within 5m, mark as model-variant-regression and notify research@redwood.com`.
Sam: noted. Thanks team.
oncall-bot: Reminder: please add participant recs to the handoff note: primary_until=1729464000, coverage_zone=EU-night, actions_taken=[rollback_model, concurrency_reduce, kv_prefetch_toggle].
Priya: added to ticket. Signing off from bridge but on pager.
Evelyn: closing notes: we'll convert this into an ops-runbook edit and link customers in SUP-3328. Good coordination. :clap:
